summary: Frontend-only regression to verify TDZ fix for isPhoneNow in AppContext. Tested desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) with 3 reloads, navigation to /parametres and /oeuvre/{id}. NO TDZ errors, NO console errors, NO black screen. HTML data-textscale/data-poster correctly resolved per device.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.js: phoneMQ/isPhoneNow correctly declared before useState(posterSize)/useState(textScale) - TDZ fix is in place at lines 50-60.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TDZ bug 'isPhoneNow before initialization' fully resolved. Verified: desktop attrs {textscale:'grand',poster:'normal'}, mobile attrs {textscale:'petit',poster:'compact'} after clearing per-device keys. D-pad testids all present (dpad-up/down/left/right/ok); dpad-ok navigates to /oeuvre/{id} (focused view). Settings page loads without intro-manager for visitor. 3 successive reloads on desktop produced zero pageerror/console.error events.
rca of the issue: TDZ (Temporal Dead Zone): useState initializers called isPhoneNow() before phoneMQ/isPhoneNow were declared. Fix: hoist phoneMQ and isPhoneNow declarations above useState hooks that reference them. Verified in AppContext.js:50-60.
